name: What interior home renovations offer the best return on investment?

mainEntity.name: What interior home renovations offer the best return on investment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen and bathroom remodels consistently provide a high return on investment due to their impact on daily living and resale value. Basement finishing, adding a deck, and energy-efficient upgrades like new windows or insulation also tend to be good investments. Focus on improvements that enhance functionality, aesthetics, and energy efficiency, as these are highly valued by potential buyers. Consider updates that address current home deficiencies or significantly improve comfort and usability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchens, bathrooms, and energy-efficient upgrades offer the best return on investment.
